groups.title: Public group addresses
groups.description: Addresses like https://www.facebook.com/groups/groupname or .../groups/1234567890. Only public groups can be read without a login.

maxPostsPerGroup.title: Posts per group
maxPostsPerGroup.description: Upper limit of unique public posts returned for each group (up to 500).

maxSessionAttempts.title: Anonymous session attempts
maxSessionAttempts.description: Maximum fresh anonymous residential HTTP sessions tried per group. Stops early when the requested post count is reached. Login/block sessions are discarded rather than reused.

includeAuthors.title: Include author names
includeAuthors.description: Off by default so personal names are not collected unless you need them.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. By default the Actor uses Apify residential proxies and fresh anonymous sessions. The Actor never logs into Facebook or supplies Facebook account cookies.
